title: INGKA Cloud portal
content:
The platforms that we currently buy via INGKA is AWS and Alicloud. IKEA IT has a Cloud portal for managing cloud accounts. The account management integration to the Cloud portal is slightly different for AWS and Alicloud se relevant page for more information. To be able to access the cloud portal you need to create account and have it linked to your Inter user, pleas talk to cloud support for this.

Note that the DevOps team i.e. DevOps@inter.ikea.com should always be set as technical contact when creating new accounts. This will ensure that DevOps team has an overview of cloud accounts.

Support mail: cloud.support@ikea.com

From Cloud Support team:

Cloud Management Services has moved over to Jira to handle and track our incoming tasks and requests better. The new e-mail for all cloud related inquiries is


cloud.support@ikea.com


You will receive a confirmation e-mail that your request has been received. Future correspondence will go through Jira. You can use both e-mail and the Jira portal to read, respond and review correspondence related to your case.
